::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2022 in Bengaluru by Gaurab Banerjee (IISc). Backed by an AMD India deep-tech innovation fund.
:::

## What does this firm design?

All-weather radar-on-chip products for safety, security, smart infrastructure, edge computing, drone detection, and emerging 6G sensor networks — one base design addressing multiple applications.
